notes: מִן → *by reason of* is headed on *reason*, the content word the phrase turns on (rule 24's explicit ruling).

The ASV writes the modal and the negation as separate words (*can ... nothing*), so rule 35's indivisible *cannot* does not reach this clause: יָכֹל keeps *I can do* headed on *can* and לֹא takes the *nothing* its negation has become (rules 35, 15).
